summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing UK-style PDMR transaction notifications, the US equivalent of Section 16 insider reports. The disclosures cover dividend reinvestment purchases of GSK ordinary shares (31p each; ISIN GB00BN7SWP63) at 17.5904 per share on 2026-10-08 on the London Stock Exchange, triggered by the dividend paid that date. Named insiders include Chief Executive Officer Luke Miels (23.331 shares), President Europe Lynn Baxter (297.818), President International Mike Crichton (1.100), Group General Counsel James Ford (2,014.345), and President Global Product Strategy Nina Mojas. No board recommendation, advisor, stake change, or corporate-action mechanics appear. No deal terms, so no risk-arb angle.
